map.出血风险权衡：启动抗凝前用 HAS-BLED 评估，高出血风险（≥3）并非停用抗: Bleeding risk trade-off: run HAS-BLED before starting anticoagulation; high bleeding risk (>=3) is not a reason to stop anticoagulation but to correct reversible factors (blood pressure, INR, drugs).
map.可选华法林（需监测 INR 2.0–3.0）或新型口服抗凝药（DOAC，如达比加: Warfarin is an option (needs INR monitoring at 2.0-3.0) as are direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs such as dabigatran or rivaroxaban, depending on kidney function). Drug choice depends on kidney function, adherence, cost and bleeding history; never switch or stop on your own.
map.女性单独作为危险因素权重较低，指南将「单纯女性」从抗凝指征中剔除：男性 ≥2 分: Female sex alone carries a low weight as a risk factor, and the guidelines remove "female sex alone" from the anticoagulation indication: anticoagulation is recommended at >=2 for men and >=3 for women; 1 for men or 2 for women is a grey zone decided individually after weighing benefit against bleeding.
map.定期复查肾功能、血常规，关注黑便/血尿/牙龈出血等信号；合并用药（抗血小板、NS: Monitor kidney function and blood counts regularly, watching for black stool, haematuria and bleeding gums; combined medication (antiplatelet, NSAID) needs physician review. Even with high bleeding risk, controlling reversible factors takes priority over blindly stopping anticoagulation.
